statement_map.email_excerpt: You came to us because your custom domain had been showing a "site can't be reached" error for three days, although your funnel worked on the FlexiFunnels link.
Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record and added a CNAME record using the target value from your FlexiFunnels domain settings, and you confirmed your domain now loads.
Following our guidance, you deleted the second www record and added a CNAME for www with the same target value, and you confirmed that both your domain and its www version now load your funnel.
We confirmed it was not a browser cache problem, since the same error showed in an incognito window.
We explained that an old A record pointing to an old server address was blocking the connection.
We explained that the padlock for the secure certificate can take some time to appear after your domain connects.
We will check that your secure certificate has been issued and message you if it has not (tomorrow morning).
